scope: Full SHA-1 article only: FIPS 180-4's definition, padding, message schedule, 80-step compression function, test vectors, the SHA-0 lineage, NIST usage policy, the 2005 Wang-Yin-Yu collision attack, the 2017 SHAttered collision, the 2020 chosen-prefix collision and the HMAC-SHA-1 test vectors. No completion claim for SHA-2, SHA-3, SHA-0 as a separate entity, RIPEMD, HMAC as a standalone entity, TLS, Git or any other protocol or implementation.

coverageRationale.zh: 专门解释 FIPS 180-4 定义的 SHA-1：512 位块、160 位摘要、填充与 64 位大端长度、五个初始字、80 字消息表、Ch/Parity/Maj 三函数、四个 20 步阶段、四组轮常量、回加与大端输出；覆盖 SHA-0 到 SHA-1 的谱系、RFC 3174 的测试向量、NIST 的用途分级、Wang-Yin-Yu 2005、SHAttered 2017、Shambles 2020 的碰撞时间线，以及 HMAC-SHA-1 的 RFC 2202 向量。不把 SHA-2、SHA-3、SHA-0 实体、HMAC 本身或整个哈希家族并入本实体。
coverageRationale.en: Covers FIPS 180-4's SHA-1: 512-bit blocks, the 160-bit digest, padding and the 64-bit big-endian length, the five initial words, the 80-word message schedule, the Ch/Parity/Maj functions, four 20-step stages, the four round constants, the feed-forward and the big-endian output; the SHA-0 lineage, RFC 3174's test vectors, NIST's use categories, the collision timeline from Wang-Yin-Yu 2005 through SHAttered 2017 and Shambles 2020, and the HMAC-SHA-1 vectors of RFC 2202. It does not absorb SHA-2, SHA-3, the SHA-0 entity, HMAC itself or the whole hash family.

entry.relatedPolicy: These are distinct catalog entities. They are linked for context only and are not aliases, merged identities or completed by this article. MD4 and MD5 are the earlier MD-family designs; SHA-2 and SHA-3 are separate hash families with their own entities; FIPS 180-4 is the standard document; HMAC is the construction whose SHA-1 instantiation is discussed here. The term--sha-1 record was merged into sha1 in this round; the fips202 standard entity and its keccak alias ambiguity are deliberately separate from sha3.
